method: Native SVG backing, pattern and surface opacity changes only. Reused photograph/cutout and presentation sources remain unchanged. No photographic editing, blurring, new generation, crop or foreground changes.

examples.name: background-studio-invitation
examples.description: Only text-backing opacity changes 0→1. The cream rectangle stays at x85/y490/440×230. The source photograph, crop, native copy, typography, all coordinates, paper and lighting remain identical. The rest of the photograph remains untreated.

examples.name: background-pitcher-texture
examples.description: Only backdrop-pattern opacity changes 0.65→0.1 on a fixed #e7e3d8 field. The same native wave pattern and identical RGBA pitcher cutout stay in place. Source bytes, alpha, object scale, copy, font settings, paper and lighting remain identical. This is a photographic cutout on a designed backdrop, not a retouched scene.

examples.name: background-booking-surface
examples.description: Only booking-surface opacity changes 0.66→1. The cream rectangle stays at x150/y405/310×280. Photograph bytes/crop, all text, button, spacing, phone stage and lighting stay fixed. The photograph remains visible above and around the surface. This is a static fictional booking page.
